hints.title: Denomination Array Alignment
hints.text: The 5 banknote values are [20, 50, 100, 200, 500], aligned with indices 0 through 4.

hints.title: Greedy Highest-Value Dispensation
hints.text: Withdrawals must greedily dispense the largest available banknotes first, starting from 500 down to 20.

hints.title: Transaction Rollback
hints.text: Calculate the needed counts speculatively. If the remaining amount is not exactly 0, discard the transaction and return [-1] without modifying bank reserves.

hints.title: Greedy ATM Class Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) per deposit and withdraw operation
complexity.notes: Every deposit and withdrawal loops through 5 fixed denominations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying counts before ensuring the total amount can be satisfied leaves the machine in an inconsistent state on failed withdrawals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements atomic rollback and descending greedy denomination extraction.

solutions.approach: Fixed-Size Greedy Array with Atomic Rollback
